head.text: PROPOSED (changes.md CS1): RTC read with the device acknowledge - 2 wait states

signal.name: state
signal.data: S0 S1 S2 Sw Sw Sw Sw S3 S4 S5 S0 S1

foot.text: Proposed. DEVMAP gets AS directly (rework wire) and BUSCTRL's region select early (address only), so device selects follow AS by one CPLD level. A falling-edge counter starts with AS. nDEV_ACK stays high (not ready) until the selected device's count is reached; for the RTC that is count 2, giving 2 wait states. UART, INTCTRL, LEDs and PTC acknowledge at count 0 (no wait states). Cards acknowledge through nEXP_ACK. BUSCTRL turns nDEV_ACK into DSACK and never retracts it.
